validation.note: `resolved` = SWE-bench tracked resolution (all F2P+P2P pass); the gold patch satisfies it for every task. `command_resolved` is stricter: tracked-resolved AND the selected test command had zero untracked failures AND exit code 0. `eval_grade` is `command_resolved` AND p2p_count>0 (has a regression guard) — the benchmark-grade subset. All tasks are valid for training.
